name: Cork Airport

runway.v: Main runway 16/34, 2,133 m × 45 m; second runway 07/25, 1,310 m × 45 m

hours.v: Aerodrome H24; closed on Christmas Day
hours.quote: Airport closed on Christmas Day. Exact HR advised by NOTAM

customs.v: Customs and immigration 24 hours, prior notice to the aerodrome operator
customs.quote: H24 PN required to AD Operator

ppr.v: PPR for landing is mandatory; a flight plan is not PPR
ppr.quote: Prior permission required (PPR) for landing is mandatory at Cork Airport.

handling.v: Ground handling is compulsory for all aircraft
handling.quote: All aircraft must avail of ground handling.

fuel.v: Jet A1 and Avgas 100LL; full facilities 05:30–22:00 local every day (AD 2.3 lists fuelling H24)
fuel.quote: Full facilities are available daily 0530-2200HR local time all year.

noise.v: CAT C/D departures straight ahead to 2,500 ft QNH before turning
noise.quote: must maintain straight ahead after take-off until passing 2500ft QNH before commencing turn.

notes: Read the Irish eAIP EI AD 2 EICK page valid from 11 Jun 2026 (AIRAC folder 2026-05-14). AIRAC Amendment 008/26 (effective 06 Aug 2026) reissued the EICK pages and changed AD 2.16 and AD 2.20; that edition could not be opened (permission not granted), and Amendment 009/26 (03 Sep 2026) makes no EICK change. Whether a later amendment in force on 25 Nov 2026 touches EICK was not checked. Re-check AD 2.20 (handling rule) against the current edition. No night restriction is listed in AD 2.20/2.21, but the AIP does not state 'no restriction', so curfew is left missing. Fuel hours conflict: AD 2.3 says fuelling H24, AD 2.4 says full facilities 05:30–22:00.
